negative_item_policy: Do not copy legacy penalties. Add only a separately evidenced harmful action with visible policy basis, explicit non-overlap and cross-profile shared semantics; log external acceptance gap until reviewed.
score_uncertainty: If a required fact cannot be safely determined, report JUDGE_ERROR and no total. Unknown is not zero.
equivalence: Accept business-equivalent layouts and formulas. Preserve source-native structure only where explicitly requested. No use of oracle values to choose candidate regions.
